en.title: Must-Watch Marvel Before Avengers: Doomsday: Your Essential MCU Guide
en.summary: Avengers: Doomsday is on the horizon, and with only months left, a rewatch of crucial MCU entries is in order. Disney has curated a list of essential viewing to prepare fans.
en.body:
The countdown to **Avengers: Doomsday** has officially begun, and with the monumental event just months away, it's the perfect time to revisit the Marvel Cinematic Universe's most pivotal moments. Whether you're a seasoned fan looking to refresh your memory or a newer viewer aiming to fill in the gaps, a select few titles stand out as absolutely essential viewing.

Disney has provided guidance on what to prioritize, and thankfully, it doesn't require a complete rewatch of the entire sprawling saga. The most critical recent entries that directly set the stage for **Avengers: Doomsday** include **Avengers: Endgame**, the epic conclusion to the Infinity Saga that reshaped the MCU; **Loki** Season 2, which deeply explored the intricacies of the multiverse; **Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness**, a mind-bending journey that established key rules for alternate realities; and **What If...?** Season 2, which presented storylines adjacent to the looming threat of Doomsday.

These selections are crucial for understanding the complex narrative threads that will undoubtedly converge in **Avengers: Doomsday**. **Endgame** is non-negotiable for its foundational payoff, while **Loki** and **Doctor Strange** are vital for grasping the mechanics and implications of the multiverse, a concept central to the upcoming film. **What If...?** Season 2, though animated, offers narrative beats that resonate with the overarching conflict.

## The Multiverse Beckons

Beyond these core titles, other recent projects offer significant context. **Spider-Man: No Way Home** was a groundbreaking exploration of the multiverse's chaotic potential, directly impacting Peter Parker and introducing characters who will likely play larger roles. The groundwork laid in **WandaVision**, while more character-focused, also introduced elements that ripple through the multiverse narrative. For those looking even further back, **Avengers: Infinity War** remains a critical watch for understanding the initial threat and the sacrifices made.

## What's Next on the MCU Horizon

The anticipation for **Avengers: Doomsday** is palpable, and the MCU is gearing up for a massive slate of interconnected stories. While specific details about **Doomsday** are kept under wraps, the trajectory clearly points towards a grand culmination of the Multiverse Saga. Fans can expect further exploration of these themes in upcoming projects like **Deadpool & Wolverine** and **The Fantastic Four: First Steps**, which are poised to introduce new dynamics and characters into the fray, all building towards the ultimate confrontation.

content_raw: Avengers: Doomsday is almost upon us. With only three months to go, it’s time to go back and watch other Marvel movies and shows to refresh your memories or to fill in gaps with projects you might have missed. You don’t have to watch everything, though. Disney has helpfully put together a list of essential viewing detailing everything you need to watch before Doomsday.
